About Me

I'm a software engineer, a father of four, and resident of Portland, Oregon.

Professional

Previously, I founded NSHipster and created some of the most widely used open-source libraries in the Apple ecosystem, including AFNetworking and Alamofire. I've worked at Apple, GitHub, Heroku, and Replicate. My code runs on the majority of Apple devices worldwide.

Civic Action

I'm the lead petitioner for MultNoMo, a grassroots initiative to consolidate the governments of Portland and Multnomah County.

I'm beginning Portland State University's Executive Master in Public Administration program this fall.

Personal

I live in the Alphabet District in a Victorian house built before automobiles. My family is car-free. Most days I take my kids to school on a cargo e-trike 🛺

I believe the means justify the ends: the integrity of the process determines the quality of the outcome.

Daisuke Majima (MLBoy) — on-device AI, iOS & Android

400+ open models on Hugging Face, converted to LiteRT, Core AI and ExecuTorch and measured on phones. 163 of them in litert-community. PRs merged in litert-samples (32) and executorch (9). I write as MLBoy on Zenn, Medium and Qiita.

For local chat, speech or image understanding in a Swift app, start here to try the Mac app, choose a model and find package examples. CoreAIKit Skills helps your coding agent resolve model IDs, release pins and device variants before adding the feature.

coreai-model-zoo — downloadable Core AI models with recipes and validation records · CoreAIKit — Swift APIs for local models · devicemark — on-device LLM leaderboard for iPhone · The Art of Core AI — the textbook (JA, free; EN)

CoreML-Models ⭐1.8k · LiteRT-Models · VLMKit · ex-Ultralytics (YOLO on mobile) · 10 apps on the App Store · Osaka, Japan (JST)

Models: Hugging Face · litert-community · coreai-community

What people hire me for
Ship a model on-device PyTorch / ONNX → Core ML or LiteRT, production-ready, not a demo
Make it fast Latency and memory — quantization, palettization, ANE / GPU / NPU tuning
Real-time camera & video Detection, tracking, segmentation at frame rate
On-device VLM / LLM Structured extraction and generation, fully offline
Train or fine-tune Building the model for the target device, not only deploying someone else's weights

Small, well-scoped pieces are welcome as well as longer engagements.

Get in touch

📧 rockyshikoku@gmail.com — I reply within a day 🌐 john-rocky.github.io — shipped apps, past work, details

Freelance through Pebble Inc. (Osaka, JST) — currently taking projects. Remote; occasional travel is fine.

Hey there 👋

  • I'm into the internet, traveling, reading, and listening to music - still figuring out this whole "living life" thing.

  • Want to know more? Check out my website here: EN, 中文.

What I'm Exploring

  • Agent harnesses end to end: from ReAct loops to sandbox infrastructure, with strong product sense across the stack.
  • Multi-agent systems: orchestrators, lead agents, A2A collaboration, and durable execution workflows.
  • Whatever feels worth building: vibe coding, open source, and time are tools; curiosity and relentless tinkering are the constants.

Products I'm Building

  • 🎙️ HeyYo - AI dictation app that turns messy speech into clean, paste-ready writing across apps. (Architecture Evolution)

  • 📈 Visual HTML Gen UI - Standalone HTML chart skill for Gen-UI agents and generated UI workflows.
  • 🎨 Open Claude Gen UI - Streaming Claude-style Gen UI in chat.
  • 🌉 Unla - MCP gateway for turning existing MCP servers and APIs into MCP servers with zero code changes.
  • 🎨 DESIGN.md - Drop-in design-system references for coding agents.

Archived Projects

  • 📕 RedNote MCP - MCP server for accessing RedNote / Xiaohongshu from AI agents.
  • 🛠️ OpenHands - AI-driven development platform.

The Real Boss

He's the one who keeps a light on for me, just like a furry little butler.
